about.player.fire: You're the one who put out the fire. Drinks are on me.
You carried water when the roofs were burning. I saw you.

about.player.fire.text: I won't forget you at the fire, {player}. None of us will.

about.player.theft: I know what you did. Keep your hands where I can see them.
Hands out of my sight, if you please.
about.player.murder: Get away from me. I know what you are.
You've blood on you. Leave me be.
Murderer. Go, before I call the watch.
about.player.assault: You're the one with the fists. Keep them down.
I saw you strike a man. Stay back.
about.player.quest: You did right by us. I hear it everywhere.
You're the one who helped. Thank you, truly.
Folk say you get things done. They're not wrong.
about.player.let_down: You said you'd help. Then nothing.
about.player.defender: You stood at the gate when they came. I owe you my life, maybe.
You fought for us. Sit, eat something.
The beasts ran from you. I saw it with my own eyes.
about.player.gift: That gift you gave... it was kind. Kinder than you know.
about.player.rescue: You saved one of ours. Bless you.
If you ever need anything, you've only to ask. After what you did.
about.player.donor: Your coin built the well. My children drink from it.
about.player.builder: You helped mend the roofs. That's neighbourly.
Your hands were in that stonework. Good hands.
about.player.fugitive: Last I heard, the guards were after you.
Running from the watch, weren't you? I'll not be caught helping.
about.player.punished: You paid your debt to the town. Fair enough.
Saw you in the pillory. No hard feelings, I hope.
about.player.round: You bought the house a round! Generous soul.
Next one's on me. Well, maybe.
about.player.pious: Good to see you at service.
You keep the rest day. That's well.
about.player.rude: You've a sharp tongue. I heard what you said to the baker.
about.player.trouble: I've heard about you. Behave yourself here.
about.player.poacher: The lord's deer, was it? Careful.
Poaching's a hanging matter in some towns.
about.player.neighbour: You've a house here now. You're one of us, near enough.
about.player.kindness: You helped one of ours when nobody else did. I heard.
Kind of you, what you did. Word gets about.
about.player.good: Folk speak well of you here.
Your name's a good one in this town.

about.player.good.text: Welcome back, {player}. You're well thought of.

about.player.bad: People talk about you. Not kindly.
Your name's mud here, you know.
remember.last.fire: Back again? Last time you were up to your elbows in fire buckets.
remember.last.theft: Back again? Last time, my things went missing.
remember.last.murder: You. Last time you were here, someone died.
remember.last.assault: Back again? Last time you came swinging.
remember.last.quest: Back again? Last time you did me a good turn.
Ah, you. You helped me last time.
remember.last.let_down: Back again? You never finished what you promised me.
remember.last.defender: You again! Last I saw you, you had a sword in your hand and beasts at the gate.
remember.last.gift: Back again? I still have your gift.
remember.last.rescue: You! Last time you pulled me out of a fix.
remember.last.donor: Back again? Your coin's still in the well-stones.
remember.last.builder: You again. Your mortar's still holding.
remember.last.fugitive: Last I saw you, you were running from the guards.
Back? Last time you left at a run, with the watch behind you.
remember.last.punished: Last I saw you, you were in the pillory. You look better.
remember.last.round: You again! Last time you bought the round. Your turn again?
remember.last.pious: Back again? I saw you at service last time.
remember.last.rude: Back again? Last time you were rude to me.
remember.last.trouble: Back again? Last time there was trouble.
remember.last.poacher: Back again? With venison this time?
remember.last.kindness: Back again? You were kind to me last time.
lives.story.by_you: I haven't forgotten your part in it, {player}.
You were there for it. I remember.
Whatever folk say, I know what you did.

lives.story.by_you.text: You've a long memory in this town now, {player}. So have I.

lives.story.by_other: {helper} had a hand in it, you know.
Did you hear what {helper} did? A stranger, too.
It was {helper} who stepped in. Folk still talk of it.
Ask {helper}, if you see them. They know the whole of it.
remember.last.good: Back again? Good to see you.
You again. Last time went well, as I recall.
remember.last.bad: You again. Last time didn't go well.
